name: vague broker — most fields must stay null

turns.text: Hello — I'm an AI assistant calling for a tenant about your listing in Hinjewadi. This will take under a minute, and I am recording it so she can hear your answers. Is that alright?
Haan, but I am driving, make it fast.
When can she come and see the flat?
Let me check with owner and call back. Should be okay I think.
What's the rent and the deposit right now?
Rent is negotiable, depends on the party. Deposit also we can discuss.
Is there a brokerage on top, and how much?
Is non-veg allowed in the building?
I have to ask the society. Listen, I am driving, call me later.
Understood, thank you for your time.
